title: Anzac biscuits
hookLine: Australian-inspired anzac biscuits with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Anzac biscuits
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Put the oats, coconut, flour and sugar in a bowl. Melt the butter in a small pan and stir in the golden syrup. Add the bicarbonate of soda to 2 tbsp boiling water, then stir into the golden syrup and butter mixture. Incorporate {m53111_1}, {m53111_2}, {m53111_3}, and {m53111_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure porridge oats first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Anzac biscuits
steps.instructionTemplate: Make a well in the middle of the dry ingredients and pour in the butter and golden syrup mixture. Stir gently to incorporate the dry ingredients. Incorporate {m53111_5}, {m53111_6}, and {m53111_7} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Bake Anzac biscuits & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 18 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Put dessertspoonfuls of the mixture on to buttered baking sheets, about 2.5cm/1in apart to allow room for spreading. Bake in batches for 8-10 mins until golden. Transfer to a wire rack to cool.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
